bluestate.t: Blue State / Candid, "Brand discovery in the age of AI" (Nov 2025): 4.5% of donors use AI to find causes; AI traffic to nonprofit sites +1000% YoY, organic search −35%

similarweb.t: Similarweb gen-AI landscape: 770.7M AI referral visits/month, +117% YoY; ChatGPT share fell from ~76% to ~53% in a year

pew.t: Pew Research (Jul 2025): users click a result on 8% of searches with an AI Overview vs 15% without; 1% click AIO citations

epoch.t: Epoch AI, "The plunging price of thought" (2026): inference price per capability falling ~13× per year since 2023

bis.t: US export-control directive (12 Jun 2026): access to Claude Fable 5 / Mythos 5 suspended worldwide; restored 1 Jul. 19 days

genrep.t: Stewardship Generosity Report 2026 (n=6,004): people who trust their church "a lot" make up 74% of givers; prompt-driven giving −11%

fai.t: Fundraising.AI donor survey (Aug 2025, n=1,031): top concern (34%) is AI bots posing as humans for a charity

footprint.t: Charity AI Brand Footprint (Q3 2025): across 110 donor prompts, chatbots lean on validators (Charity Navigator, GiveWell); UK Christian causes largely absent

slywotzky.t: Slywotzky, Value Migration (1996): value moves to the layer that stays scarce when neighbours commoditise

rand.t: Dewar, Assumption-Based Planning (RAND, 2002): load-bearing assumptions, signposts, hedging actions

tetlock.t: Tetlock & Gardner, Superforecasting (2015): small frequent updates; record reasoning before outcomes

mcgrath.t: McGrath & MacMillan, Discovery-Driven Planning (HBR 1995): write assumptions down, convert to checkpoints
